reassignments.rationale: Frozen GIF control the pinned reference draws completely (reference-collected in tests/oracle/gif-container): the record's malformed owner requires the renderer to equal the reference exactly in PNG and PDF at the natural size and to keep its octets in SVG. See docs/research/gif-umbrella-facets.md.

Frozen GIF control the pinned reference rejects, or whose first frame it paints only partially (reference-collected; the declared divergence, #85): exact all-format decode-failed reports, missing-asset artifact equivalence, extents and replay; the suite selects exactly the record's strict controls. See docs/research/gif-umbrella-facets.md.

owners.rationale: GIF orientation facet: GIF has no orientation; XMP tiff:Orientation, also oversized, is ignored exactly as the reference ignores it. See docs/research/gif-umbrella-facets.md.

GIF color-profile facet: the global or local palette is the only color model; ICC application extensions (transforming, unparseable, trailing, oversized) are never applied, as the reference never applies them; with the 240-vector palette/transparency/interlace first-frame matrix. See docs/research/gif-umbrella-facets.md.

GIF malformed facet: container faults the reference tolerates draw exactly like the reference; faults it rejects, and first frames it paints only partially (the declared divergence), recover exactly; the 48 frozen controls reference-collected. See docs/research/gif-umbrella-facets.md.
GIF passthrough facet: direct SVG embeds the exact octets of every admitted row of the 97-row record and recovers the rest exactly. See docs/research/gif-umbrella-facets.md.

GIF alpha facet: transparent indices (also out of palette range), out-of-palette indices drawn opaque black, a missing palette, exact PDF alpha and soft mask; with the first-frame transparency matrix. See docs/research/gif-umbrella-facets.md.

GIF default-frame and animation facets: the canvas grows to the first frame's extent (natural sizes asserted against the reference); zero-size first frames and image-less files draw a transparent screen; data after a complete first frame is ignored; later frames only count; PNG/PDF flatten with one informational diagnostic; with the first-frame and two-frame control records. See docs/research/gif-umbrella-facets.md.

GIF limits facet: byte, dimension, pixel and work equality and exact first crossing (the attempted total) for still, transparent and animated GIF in every format with exact reports and recovery, and the spec 13.2 multi-crossing precedence. See docs/research/gif-umbrella-facets.md.
